title: Boundary-Aware Input Bit Formula
statement: For every Boolean word $y$ and natural-number position $p$, the boundary-aware input read is absent unless $1\le p\le |y|$; in that range it is the bit at zero-based position $p-1$, with false as the default value.
replaced: For every word $y$ and position $p$, the input symbol at $p$ is the bit of $y$ at $p - 1$ when $0 < p \le |y|$ and a blank otherwise.
